title: Almost a good idea
text: Almost a good idea. I am trying to learn fermentation. So I bought this. I am making Sauerkraut. They almost have this device right. If they would have put fine screens over the holes to actually keep the food under the plunger it would have been useful. Especially since it's a liquid brine. But as it stands when the plunger goes down the food comes up through the large holes! What a waste of money. I could have got the same conclusion if left to my own devices. Which is why I thought I was purchasing an answer to my problem, keeping the food under the brine not above it.

product_metadata.title: Kraut Source Fermentation Lid
features: Makes fermenting foods like sauerkraut, pickles, salsa, kimchi and more fun and easy.
It fits on standard wide-mouth mason jars*, allowing you make pint, quart, or half-gallon sized batches depending on your needs.
Specially designed to keep air out and fermenting fruits and veggies submerged in brine.
Includes 1 FDA food-grade silicone gasket attached and 1 replacement gasket, instruction manual.
*A mason jar is not included with this product.
